checkpoint_restore.native_src_run: Explicit cfg.model SMART_GAIL is instantiated, then Trainer.test(...ckpt_path=...) restores checkpoint[state_dict] strictly by LightningModule.strict_loading (default true). It does not reconstruct a model from checkpoint hyper_parameters; the materialized model config must match.
checkpoint_restore.sweep: Same SMART_GAIL target and state_dict; evaluation rebuilds CPU model, strict=True state load, then calibration verification and separate GEN reseed.
checkpoint_restore.top_level_metadata: scratch_sweep and scratch_sweep_rng are extra top-level checkpoint metadata, not unexpected state_dict keys. Native TEST does not install ScratchDiagnostics.on_train_start and does not restore saved training RNG; TEST does not restore training optimizers/schedulers.
checkpoint_restore.EMA: encoder.init_decoder._extra_state stores ema + named shadow parameters and denoiser/type/ego layout. set_extra_state validates saved size/denoiser/context options; post-load hook validates EMA names/shapes and restores decay/shadows/num_updates. Eval forward applies ema.average_parameters because model.training=false and use_ema=true.
checkpoint_restore.normalizer_map: Persistent G1 normalizer buffers and full encoder.map_encoder state restore from trained checkpoint. Native eval explicitly clears startup AIRL initial_map_checkpoint and normalizer_path to prevent extra map load or calibration overwrite. sep_map=false keeps shared fixed map; eval() also disables map dropout.
checkpoint_restore.SMARTDecoder_extra_state: encoder._extra_state accepts the saved initial_map_ema mapping; released fixed shared-map runs have no initial map EMA. Native config inherits sep_map=false.
checkpoint_restore.native_weights_only_support: Installed Lightning cloud_io torch.load uses weights_only=False by default and can deserialize non-tensor extra_state mapping; current torch2.7 default weights_only behavior therefore does not silently drop EMA in the native path.
checkpoint_restore.unverified_until_actual_smoke: No actual final checkpoint bytes or load tested here. Materializer final metadata gate + strict native smoke must establish final tensor/layout/EMA budget compatibility; source reading alone cannot certify an absent/incomplete final checkpoint.

seed_timing.native: src/run.py seeds cfg.seed once before datamodule/model/callback/Trainer instantiate. Model CPU parameter initialization advances the CPU RNG even when all persistent weights are later overwritten by checkpoint.
seed_timing.sweep: Seeds TRAIN before model instantiate; later evaluate(model,...) reseeds GEN after instantiate+state load and before Trainer.test. Thus sweep starts evaluation with an explicitly fresh CPU/Python/NumPy/CUDA GEN state.
seed_timing.native_test_start_hook: SMART.on_test_epoch_start delegates on_validation_epoch_start: reset_sampling only when decoder defines it; InitDiffusion does not. It creates/resets evaluator and does not call seed_everything/manual_seed.
seed_timing.current_CUDA_noise: ScaleFlow.sample draws physical torch.randn on agent_batch.device and separate type noise on latent.device; in native/sweep GPU evaluation both are CUDA. Current TokenProcessor/InitDiffusion/SMART constructors initialize/load CPU tensors, and validation transforms are deterministic. CPU RNG divergence by itself does not establish that CUDA sampling streams differ.
seed_timing.source_supported_but_not_measured: Same initial CUDA seed may still give identical current GEN noise because no pre-sample CUDA RNG draw was identified. This is an inference from current code, not a measured CUDA RNG-state/noise identity result; other constructors, callbacks, worker setup and future source changes can invalidate it.
seed_timing.torch_initial_seed_caveat: The saved torch_initial_seed reports a seed identifier, not generator consumption/state. Equality of that field cannot certify identical physical/type source tensors.
seed_timing.minimal_smoke_comparability: Use same checkpoint/model config, same GEN seed, B128 and exact scene order, workers0, single GPU, 32-true+medium, sampling20/ODE/no new callback draw. If exact identity matters compare first-batch physical gen_noise and separate type source hashes plus output state/type hashes through a temporary diagnostic hook; such hooks are not installed now.
seed_timing.seed_does_not_affect_loaded_G1_identity: Seeding native constructor with GEN rather than TRAIN is not a weight mismatch when strict trained state and compatible EMA shadows overwrite all persistent generator parameters. Non-persistent token libraries are deterministic external resources and should retain identical source files.

native_scope.conditioning: Reference map, GT ego frame; ego position/heading/shape/type fixed, ego velocity generated; total input count and ego role; generated agent types; all recipe representations/options inherited. Control angle context versus candidate sincos context are intended arm differences.
native_scope.native_sort_order: No eval manifest override -> MultiDataset sorted .pt/.pkl files; full50k exact canonical-membership audit must stay valid. Native test loader shuffle=false/drop_last=false.
native_report_benign_differences: Native report has primary agent_metrics, feature counts and full/matched flags. Extra onroad fields and full_reference_agent_metrics are added by the sweep evaluate wrapper, not native model test hook. Derive native onroad_fraction from feature_counts_generated[1]/num_generated_vehicles; GT fraction from feature_counts_gt[1]/num_gt_vehicles.
Native does not write sweep feature_histograms.json or summary variant/budget rows. Missing wrapper diagnostics is not a metric definition change; record provenance externally.

Full50k native matched primary is mathematically the same target as full-reference GT. For partial smoke, matched primary uses only evaluated scene GT; it is strictly integration-only and must not enter selection/ranking.
native_scope.full_guard_reference: screen_spot_check.json full50k_guard: matched + require_full_set + full_membership + 50000/50000 + zero unverified timestep + reference top-level map source + official/cache backend/source and full GT counts.
native_scope.training: Native best fit starts random G1/optimizer/EMA and only AIRL map weights, not search checkpoint. Native shuffle=true 128epoch data trajectory differs from quick fixed-order repeats; short-search superiority does not prove128epoch optimum.
